description: This is a Vuex store module for managing OTA (Over-the-Air) configuration state in a Vue.js application. It defines state variables, mutations for updating OTA configuration, target/source builds, and related actions.

methods.name: REUSE_CONFIG
methods.description: Mutates the state to reuse an existing configuration object, updating otaConfig and build targets, and parsing extra flags.

methods.name: SET_CONFIG
methods.description: Sets the entire OTA configuration directly.

methods.name: RESET_CONFIG
methods.description: Resets the OTA configuration to a new default OTAConfiguration object.

methods.name: SET_TARGET
methods.description: Sets the target build in the state.

methods.name: SET_SOURCE
methods.description: Sets the source build in the state.

methods.name: SET_ISINCREMENTAL
methods.description: Sets the incremental update flag within the OTA configuration.
